description: 40x40 map using the profile's standard mapping, every cell starting as mapping 0. Paint every cell 'mud' and resolve with no region (seed 1234). Then paint a disc of 'san' (centre 20,20, radius 6: cells with dx*dx+dy*dy <= 36) and resolve with no region (seed 1234). Hash the tile grid (mapping index per cell, row by row) with FNV-1a 64 over each value's 4 little-endian bytes.
